top_signals.title: North Korea said behind GMO cyberattack ahead of CEO’s first briefing on hacking
top_signals.summary: GMO CEO Masatoshi Kumagai is set to hold the firm's first public briefing since it became embroiled in a growing scandal over a massive data breach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
